VERBOSE.description: Enable verbose user output (1 = enabled, 0 = quiet)

conf_force_conffold.description: Force retaining old conffile without user prompt (set to 'true' to enable)

conf_force_conffnew.description: Force replacing old conffile with new without user prompt (set to 'true' to enable)

conf_old_mdsum_file.description: Explicit path to historical md5sum file (if empty, standard lookup is used)
